_translation.note: Spec section 12 requires HUMAN translation for: the consent text, both signature documents, the privacy notice, and every tax ID validation error. Keys under `esign`, `privacy`, and `validation.ssn` / `validation.itin` / `validation.tin` are marked `needsCounselReview` in the Spanish catalogue and must be replaced with copy approved by the client's counsel in English and human-translated to Spanish before launch. Machine translation is not acceptable for those.
_translation.designWidth: Every screen is designed at Spanish string lengths and tested at 360px.

workerInvite.sms: {company} has asked you to complete your onboarding information. It takes about 5 minutes and your employer will not see what you enter. Start here: {url}

ownerInvite.sms: {company} has asked you to provide your owner information for tax filing. It takes about 3 minutes. Start here: {url}

reminder.sms: Reminder from {company}: your onboarding is not finished yet. Complete it here: {url}

staffSetup.subject: Set up your Onboarding account
staffSetup.body:
Hello {name},

An account has been created for you on the Onboarding platform.

Set your password and enrol your authenticator app here. The link works once and expires in 24 hours:

{url}

If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message and the link will expire on its own.

needsAttention.subject: Onboarding needs attention

verify.title: First, confirm your date of birth
verify.body: {company} sent you this link. To make sure it reached the right person, enter your date of birth.
verify.why: Your employer does not know your date of birth, so this keeps the link from working for anyone else.

expired.title: This link is no longer valid
expired.body: Links can be used once and expire after seven days.
expired.next: Ask the company that sent it to you for a new one.

locked.title: This link is locked
locked.body: Too many incorrect answers. Try again in an hour. If you did not make those attempts, tell the company that sent you this link.

welcome.title: {company} needs some information from you
welcome.what: We will ask for your legal name, address, date of birth, tax ID number, and bank details for direct deposit.
welcome.privacy: {company} will not see what you enter here. It goes only to their accounting firm, who use it to pay you and file your taxes.
welcome.time: It takes about five minutes. You can stop and come back to this link at any point — your answers are saved as you go.

name.title: What is your full legal name?
name.hint: Exactly as it appears on your Social Security card or ITIN letter.
name.middleHint: Leave blank if you do not have one.

dob.title: Is this your date of birth?
dob.hint: This is what you entered a moment ago.
dob.label: Date of birth

contact.title: How can we reach you?
contact.phoneHint: The number this link was sent to.
contact.emailHint: Optional. Only used if we need to reach you about your paperwork.

emergency.title: Emergency contact
emergency.hint: Optional. Someone we should call if something happens at work.
emergency.name: Name

tinType.title: Which tax ID number do you have?
tinType.hint: Choose the one that matches the document you hold.

SSN.title: Social Security Number
SSN.body: A nine-digit number on a Social Security card, issued by the Social Security Administration.

ITIN.title: ITIN
ITIN.body: An Individual Taxpayer Identification Number, issued by the IRS in a letter. It always starts with 9.

tin.title: Enter your tax ID number
tin.hint: Nine digits. Nobody at your workplace will see this.

bank.title: Where should you be paid?
bank.hint: This is the account your pay will be deposited into.
bank.name: Name of your bank

routing.title: Routing number
routing.hint: Nine digits, usually the leftmost number at the bottom of a check.

account.title: Account number
account.hint: Between 4 and 17 digits, to the right of the routing number.
account.label: Account number

check.title: Photo of a voided check
check.hint: This helps the accounting firm confirm your account details.
check.optional: This step is optional. You can finish without it.

notes.title: Anything else we should know?
notes.label: Notes
notes.privacy: Only the accounting firm reads this. Your employer does not see it.

sign.nameMismatch: This does not match the name you gave earlier ({expected}). You can still continue if this is how you sign your name.

done.title: All done
done.body: Thank you. Your information has gone to the accounting firm for {company}.
done.corrections: If something needs to change later, tell the company and they will send you a new link.

errors.dobFormat: Choose a month, day, and year.
errors.dobWrong: That does not match. Please check the date and try again.
errors.dobWrongRemaining: That does not match. You have {remaining} attempts left before this link is locked for an hour.
